conclusion.blocking_prerequisite: A verified exact-build native relocation transaction for the human vehicle physics owner, including chassis transform, linear/angular velocity, four wheel/suspension state, collision broadphase/contact reconciliation, a successful destination surface/overlap check, safe update phase, and rollback has not been established.

facts.claim: The ordinary participant pipeline uses CarN indices and selects named vehicle physics configuration per participant; prior hardened-derivative runtime evidence identified Car0 as human, but the exact pristine live physics owner is not proven by that evidence.
Physics setup reads Race/CarN/PlayerType and creates/links a per-car 0x2C physics handle with four wheel records.
facts.source: Exact-build Ghidra 12.1.4 decompilation of pristine retail image.

facts.claim: The per-car handle joins a dynamic physics vector and collision registration; update code iterates the car and four wheel-sized records, while the physics frame path performs two substeps.
facts.source: Exact-build Ghidra 12.1.4 decompilation; topology cross-checked against research/r-ai2/native-storage.md.

facts.claim: gaVehicleResetManager binds per-car reset state, derives recovery position from RaceLine/Progress/LastMarker, calls a service whose query methods at this vtable are no-op/false, and updates race-car output/state data and ResetNo.
facts.source: Exact-build Ghidra 12.1.4 decompilation and vtable/reference inspection.

facts.claim: The stock reset manager path does not accept a Freecam destination; its destination query returns false in this vtable, and no complete chassis-plus-wheels-plus-contact transaction or rollback was proven in the examined path.
facts.source: Call/dataflow review; absence is scoped to the recovered path and is not a whole-program proof that no private setter exists.

facts.claim: Physics/Car0/Transform is consumed in the race-start placement function alongside Race/Car0/Transform, not established as a live body setter.
The France1 Freecam certificate is a scene/lifecycle gate and does not prove native physics pointer ownership or write safety.

prior_research_interpretation.prior_claim: The exact reset/recovery downstream behavior and reset policy were unknown.
prior_research_interpretation.new_interpretation: The reset manager recovery decision path is now statically visible; whether its output transform is synchronized into the live physical body and all collision/wheel state remains unknown.

a3j1_follow_up.new_interpretation: ResetManager_Recovery_004CCC90 writes a matrix-shaped block to CarN data +0x34 and sets +0x33. A separate physics-controller path consumes the same offsets from Controller/CarN and reaches a chassis pose setter plus bounded wheel-record cleanup. Broker path alias/copy semantics between CarN and Controller/CarN are not proven, so the exact reset-to-physics edge remains open.

facts.claim: Recovery mode sets the CarN data apply byte at +0x33 and copies 16 consecutive 32-bit words to +0x34..+0x70 at 0x004CD12C; helper 0x00404E60 is a 16-word copy.
facts.remaining_uncertainty: Whether CarN Broker data aliases or propagates to Controller/CarN.

facts.claim: The per-car controller reads its Controller/CarN data +0x33/+0x34 and can call the native chassis pose/reset helper.
facts.remaining_uncertainty: This is a separate Broker path; it is not proven to be the reset output object.

facts.claim: The native helper sets chassis current and previous positions, updates orientation-related fields, and clears selected fields on four wheel records.
facts.remaining_uncertainty: Wheel fields are unnamed; no complete wheel pose, velocity, suspension, or contact-cache transaction is established.

facts.claim: ResetNo increments in recovery and the identified reader uses it to reset camera tracking.
facts.remaining_uncertainty: No ResetNo-to-physics trigger was established in the examined references.

facts.claim: Race-start placement and physics construction both reach transform-related behavior, but exact Broker key linkage and order are not proven.
facts.remaining_uncertainty: Startup placement is a candidate, not a verified relocation solution.

decision.next_action: Trace ControllerCarBrokerAccess vtable and Broker key alias/callback implementation.

a3j2_follow_up.runtime_validation: NOT_RUN; static pointer identity establishes the Broker-to-physics route

correction_to_a3j1.prior_attribution: The A3j.1 trace attributed the 64-byte transform and apply flag to the Car%d Broker object.
correction_to_a3j1.correct_attribution: ResetManager_Recovery_004CCC90 uses manager field +0x20 (Controller/Car%d, expected ControllerCarBrokerAccess) for P+0x33 and the transform at P+0x34. Manager field +0x1C (Car%d, expected gaVehicleOutputData) is used for four separate vectors at payload offsets +0xBC,+0xCC,+0xDC,+0xEC.

remaining_unknowns: reset-manager versus physics-manager scheduling and paused behavior
safe solver phase for arbitrary relocation

decision.next_action: If authorized in a later phase, investigate relocation safety invariants; do not implement or invoke teleport in A3j.2.
